collection.description: A well-meaning relative repeatedly offers unwanted advice to new parents.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (relative), a well-meaning relative, repeatedly offers unwanted advice to new parents.

choices.label: Thank Them and Set a Boundary
Take a Break from Advice-Heavy Visits

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (relative) respects the boundary and visits more comfortably.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (relative) feels hurt at first but later understands.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (relative) keeps offering advice until reminded again.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The discussion reveals that (relative) feared being left out.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The parents remain firm while acknowledging the concern.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (relative) misses the family and asks how to reconnect respectfully.
